eligibility.quote: I had no intention to declare parameters against documentation. Most probably a mistake.

loudness.quote:
# this is artificial, what I would expect
ros2 param list
/camera/camera:
  .color.image_raw.compressed.format

resolution.quote: I am in favor of moving to the fully-qualified parameter names.  I think we should come up with a way of deprecating the current behavior ... to make sure that we don't unexpectedly break users relying on this implementation, though.
